findings.summary: AIMech:GloVe (data/curated/GloVe.yaml) is the only multi-mapping record in data/curated/*.yaml that repeats one undifferentiated identity_notes sentence verbatim across all three distinct aio_mappings[].rationale targets (AIO:RepresentationLearning, AIO:word2vecCBOW, AIO:word2vecSkipGram); AIMech:MarkovRandomField (data/curated/MarkovRandomField.yaml) retains candidate-proposal phrasing ('this candidate specifically uses an undirected graph') in identity_notes and aio_mappings[0].rationale; and AIMech:CLARANSClustering, AIMech:LargeMarginNearestNeighbor, and AIMech:RelevantComponentAnalysis retain batch-discovery diary text ('No normalized identity match for this candidate was found across all 442 pinned AIO labels/scoped synonyms and 227 preceding native IDs/names/aliases. The same search identified BIRCH as an existing native record... with 79 worktree and 79 main-checkout matching lines...') inside identity_notes.
findings.title: Differentiate target-specific AIO mapping rationales in GloVe.yaml and remove candidate-proposal / batch-discovery diary text from MarkovRandomField, CLARANSClustering, LargeMarginNearestNeighbor, and RelevantComponentAnalysis

findings.disposition: Deferred to upstream berkeleybop/artificial-intelligence-ontology (src/ontology/aio-src.csv); generated data/aio/*.yaml files must remain exact projections of the pinned AIO release (AGENTS.md).
findings.summary: Pinned upstream AIO release 2026-07-22 (sources/aio/aio.json) contains three pairs of distinct class IRIs with overlapping definitions and cross-linked or duplicate synonyms: (1) AIO:AddLayer and AIO:AdditionLayer (both under AIO:TensorOperationLayer with element-wise tensor addition definitions), (2) AIO:TransformerLLM and AIO:TransformerLanguageModel (both under AIO:LargeLanguageModel with identical exact synonym 'Transformer-based LLM'), and (3) AIO:ZeroShotLearningLLM (Model -> LargeLanguageModel) and AIO:ZeroshotLearning (Network -> DeepNeuralNetwork, with exact synonym 'Zero-Shot Learning LLM'). Because data/aio/*.yaml is generated and upstream identifiers must not be locally rewritten or merged without upstream curation, these boundary overlaps are deferred to berkeleybop/artificial-intelligence-ontology.
findings.title: Defer three upstream AIO near-duplicate class pairs (AddLayer/AdditionLayer, TransformerLLM/TransformerLanguageModel, ZeroShotLearningLLM/ZeroshotLearning) to upstream ontology curation

findings.disposition: Deferred to upstream berkeleybop/artificial-intelligence-ontology (src/ontology/aio-src.csv); maintained curated records already document these upstream placement caveats in aio_mappings[].rationale and identity_notes without mutating generated data/aio/*.yaml.
findings.summary: In pinned upstream AIO release 2026-07-22 (sources/aio/aio.json), AIO:RepresentationLearning and AIO:ZeroshotLearning are placed under AIO:DeepNeuralNetwork (Network branch) with definitions beginning 'A deep neural network that...' despite denoting learning paradigms/tasks, and top-level branch AIO:TrainingStrategy (parents: [owl:Thing]) defines itself with the genus 'A preprocessing used to train machine learning models...' while AIO:Preprocessing is a sibling top-level branch. Deferred to upstream berkeleybop/artificial-intelligence-ontology because data/aio/*.yaml is generated from the pinned ontology snapshot.
findings.title: Defer upstream AIO genus-to-hierarchy mismatches on RepresentationLearning, ZeroshotLearning, and TrainingStrategy to upstream ontology curation
